integrity: The rational generating function and all-length formula have a proof by exhaustive run-parameter cases and algebraic geometric-series summation. Computational checks are finite corroboration, not the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Binary linear strings only; complete exact noiseless compositions of all factors of lengths at most three. No assertion for cyclic strings, noisy measurements, larger alphabets or longer windows; originality remains subject to independent priority verification.
title: Quartic count of binary three-fragment composition observations
